text:
mike: quick flag - reports that small tenants lost quota after yesterday's mapper deploy. looks like region_multiplier applied twice. anyone oncall?
yana: saw it too. dashboards show a discrete step at 02:13 UTC.

dee: possible double-apply in merge path. last PR added region_bias in mapper - edge shaper still had legacy region scaling.
mike: immediate mitigation idea: config override to set region_multiplier=1 for affected tenants. can ops flip?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created config override 'region_multiplier=1' for tenant group 'small-affected' at 1768890015.
yana: good. long-term we should add provenance tags to quota tokens so merges are idempotent. proposal: quota_token.provenance = ["mapper","shaper"] and only allow one writer for region_adjust.
dee: agree. also add a metric quota.merge.duplicate to catch double applies.
mike: can replay infra validate? replay-bot can run a 48h replay comparing pre/post merge behavior?

replay-bot: replay-bot: queued replay id=9421 duration=48h. finish ETA 1768893600. output /replays/9421/deltas.csv
yana: owners: dee will PR provenance + metric, mike will own rollback + runbook update, i'll run replay and signal when canary ready.
mike: thanks. quick note: don't couple mapping scale to model retrains - mapping should normalize by historical quantiles. add to postmortem.
yana: agreed. will schedule postmortem doc and update integration tests to assert single-application of region bias.
mike: done for now. keep thread updated when replay completes.
